name: Aerial survey flight — open record
summary: The same flight, composed for the commons: either party may publish the flight record.
description: Identical to the aerial survey flight in every clause but one: the disclosure regime is open, so either party may publish the process record — position at committed neighborhood grain feeding the shared airspace map the way transponder broadcasts feed aviation's. That one changed field is a different composition hash, so this is a sibling assembly, not a setting: a market or a jurisdiction that wants open flight records converges on this composition, one that does not converges on its sibling, and the protocol itself takes no side. Whether a drone market flies open or closed is decided by which sibling gets adopted — by designers competing on rules, not by the kernel.
